# App Store Metadata Template

Copy this template for each new version submission. Fill every field before submitting.

---

## App Information (one-time, version-independent)

```
App Name:         [30 chars max — include primary keyword]
Subtitle:         [30 chars max — secondary keyword, unique value prop]
Bundle ID:        com.yourcompany.yourapp  ← cannot change after first submit
SKU:              [your internal identifier — alphanumeric, your choice]
Primary Category: [e.g., Productivity / Health & Fitness / Finance]
Secondary Cat.:   [optional]
Content Rights:   ☐ I own or have rights to all content in this app
```

---

## Version Information (fill per release)

### Version Number
```
Version:          [e.g., 2.1.0]
Build:            [must be higher than last uploaded build, e.g., 210]
```

### Description
```
[Lead with the core user benefit — what problem does this solve?]
[First 3 lines appear before "More" tap — make them count]

[Feature 1 headline]
[1–2 sentence description of feature 1]

[Feature 2 headline]
[1–2 sentence description of feature 2]

[Feature 3 headline]
[1–2 sentence description of feature 3]

[Optional: social proof, awards, press mentions]

[Optional: subscription or pricing callout if relevant]

[Support: support@yourcompany.com | yourapp.com/support]

Limit: 4000 characters
Current count: [track this]
```

### Keywords
```
[keyword1,keyword2,keyword3,keyword4,keyword5,keyword6,keyword7]

Rules:
- 100 characters TOTAL including commas
- No spaces after commas
- Do NOT repeat your app name or category name (Apple indexes those separately)
- Do NOT include competitor names
- Think: synonyms, use-case phrases, audience terms
```

### What's New
```
[Version X.X — Month Year]

• [Specific fix or feature — be concrete, not vague]
• [Bug fixes and performance improvements] ← use this only if nothing specific
• [Another notable change]

[Optional thank-you to users who reported issues]

Limit: 4000 characters
```

### URLs
```
Support URL:      https://yourapp.com/support      ← required, must be live
Marketing URL:    https://yourapp.com               ← optional
Privacy Policy:   https://yourapp.com/privacy       ← required
```

---

## Age Rating Questionnaire

Answer these before submitting — Apple auto-generates the rating:

```
Cartoon or fantasy violence:           ☐ None  ☐ Infrequent  ☐ Frequent
Realistic violence:                    ☐ None  ☐ Infrequent  ☐ Frequent
Prolonged graphic violence:            ☐ No    ☐ Yes
Sexual content / nudity:               ☐ None  ☐ Mild        ☐ Frequent
Profanity / crude humor:               ☐ None  ☐ Infrequent  ☐ Frequent
Alcohol, tobacco, drugs:               ☐ None  ☐ Infrequent  ☐ Frequent
Simulated gambling:                    ☐ No    ☐ Yes
Horror / fear themes:                  ☐ None  ☐ Infrequent  ☐ Frequent
Mature / suggestive themes:            ☐ None  ☐ Infrequent  ☐ Frequent
Unrestricted web access:               ☐ No    ☐ Yes
Gambling with real money:              ☐ No    ☐ Yes
User-generated content / sharing:      ☐ No    ☐ Yes
```

## App Review Notes

```
Test Account (if login required):
  Username: 
  Password: 
  [Any special steps to reach testable state]

Notes to Reviewer:
  [Explain any non-obvious features]
  [Explain sensitive permissions, e.g.:
   "Location permission is used to show nearby store locations on the map tab."]
  [Explain any external hardware or service dependency]
```

---

## Pricing & Availability

```
Price Tier:       ☐ Free  ☐ Paid — Tier [__]  ($[amount] USD)
Release:          ☐ Auto after approval  ☐ Manual  ☐ Phased release
Territories:      ☐ All  ☐ Specific: [list]
```

---

## Encryption Declaration

```
Does your app use encryption beyond Apple's standard HTTPS/TLS?
  ☐ No  → Select "No" in App Store Connect — no ERN needed
  ☐ Yes → You may need an ERN; see https://developer.apple.com/documentation/security/complying_with_encryption_export_regulations
```

---

## Pre-Submit Final Check

```
☐ Build is "Ready to Submit" in Activity tab
☐ Screenshots uploaded for all required device sizes
☐ Description, keywords, What's New complete
☐ Support URL and Privacy Policy URL are live
☐ Age rating questionnaire complete
☐ Review notes filled in (including demo account if needed)
☐ Pricing and availability set
☐ In-App Purchases (if any) are in "Ready to Submit" state
☐ Encryption declaration answered
```
